name: regression
description: The prompt-regression GATE set (small, targeted) — mirrors Promptfoo's inline tests (k8s/promptfoo/promptfoo.yaml). A fast 'did editing the RAG prompt break something' check, NOT the comparable benchmark. Includes a deliberate off-corpus honest-negative (does it refuse rather than hallucinate?).
_comment: Keep in step with the Promptfoo config's `tests:` block — this is the git SSOT copy so the online (Langfuse)
and CI (Promptfoo) gates share fixtures. The `negative` item has no answer in the corpus ON PURPOSE: a correct
system refuses / says it cannot find it. Grade it with the `refusal` evaluator, not `groundedness`.
